about: How this repository spells the controls the ASQAV scan (vendor/asqav-compliance, .github/workflows/ai-governance.yml) looks for. Additive: the scanner's built-in patterns still apply; this only teaches it our vocabulary. Every pattern names a call that writes to the audit record, not a word that could appear in a comment. The record itself is verified by `pf provenance verify`, which blocks; this scan reports. Registry: platform/src/pf/vendor/registry.yaml (asqav-compliance).
